_usage: Copy this file to .minecraft/wurst/shopgui.json and customize for your server
_instructions: 1. Enable debug mode in AutoShopGUI settings to see screen titles and slot indices
2. Manually navigate through the shop to find the slot numbers for each step
3. Add the slot numbers to the 'navigation' array in the order you click them
5. Enable the target and run AutoShopGUI

targets._example: Buy a Diamond Sword from the Shop Keeper
_navigation_notes: Step 1: Click slot 10 to open 'Weapons' category
Step 2: Click slot 15 to select 'Diamond Sword'
Step 3: Click slot 11 to confirm purchase

targets._example: Sell Sugar canes to the farmer
_navigation_notes: Step 1: Click slot 12 to open 'Crops' category
Step 3: Click slot 11 to confirm sale

_tips: Use F3 to check exact NPC names (case-sensitive partial matches work)
Slot indices start at 0 and go left-to-right, top-to-bottom
Most chest GUIs are 9 slots wide (0-8 is row 1, 9-17 is row 2, etc.)
Enable debug mode to see what slot each item is in
The hack will automatically close the GUI after completing the trade
Only one target will run per activation (the first enabled one)
Future versions may support multiple targets in sequence
